prompt:
Subject: electrocardiogram, recording of electrical heart activity. A compact white ECG machine with dark screen showing one smooth green heartbeat trace, and a strip of white paper curling out of the front. Paper has pale pink square grid and dark red repeating stylized ECG waveform: small rounded P wave, narrow tall QRS spike, broader rounded T wave, flat interval, repeat. Focus on ECG RECORD, no patient, no electrodes or body, no floor. Whole machine and paper closed thick brown outlines. No letters or numerals.
Use only attached invidious.png as drawing-style reference. Thick rounded dark chocolate outlines, simple rounded 2D shapes, clean smooth solid color fills, few restrained flat shadow shapes. No watercolor, grain, mottling, speckles, paper texture, bleed, muddy patches or fuzzy edges. Every person has exactly two naturally attached arms and hands connected naturally to sleeves and shoulders. Transparent background, no detached ground shadows. All silhouettes clean smooth closed outlined shapes including water or grass. Avoid light beams, wind swirls and glows unless essential to word meaning. 512x512 PNG RGBA, no text.
en: An electrocardiogram records heart activity as a repeating waveform.
ja: 心電図装置の画面と方眼紙に、繰り返す心臓の電気信号の波形が表示されている。
